scripts.build:client: bun run check:toolchain && bun run --filter @loot-game/client build
scripts.build:client:verify: CLERK_SECRET_KEY=release-private-clerk-sentinel DATABASE_URL=release-private-database-sentinel DOPPLER_TOKEN=release-private-doppler-sentinel bun run build:client && bun run release:artifact
scripts.deploy: bun run --filter @loot-game/client build:cloudflare && bun run --filter @loot-game/server deploy:cloudflare
scripts.deploy:doppler: bun run build:client:production && bun run --filter @loot-game/server deploy
scripts.typecheck:all: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:battle && bun scripts/typecheck-complete.ts
scripts.test:release:verifier: bun test scripts/release-verify.test.ts scripts/typecheck-complete.test.ts scripts/database-safety.test.ts scripts/release-artifact.test.ts
scripts.release:check: bun run check:toolchain && bun run check:protected && bun run typecheck:all && bun run test:release:verifier && bun run test:database && bun run test:release && bun run build:client:verify && git diff --check
